Title: Meresoft Banners
Description: A free banner manager for Umbraco 17: zones, weighted rotation, schedules, impression and click limits, viewable impression statistics, draft and publish. No cookies, no personal data.

Screenshots.Caption: One package and one tag helper: place a zone in a template, manage its banners in the back office.
All banners in one list, with their state (draft, published, scheduled, expired) and zones.
An image banner: a picture from the media library, a link and alt text. Save keeps a draft, Publish makes it live.
Weighted rotation, a schedule, impression and click limits, and the zones a banner appears in.
Zones are named places in your templates, each showing one or more banners at once.
Viewable impressions and clicks per day, for any period, zone or banner, with CSV export.
Impressions, clicks and click rate for each banner in each zone. Sample data.
